findings.obligation: P4: empty state only after a successful empty load, never while loading or after a failure or refusal; fresh instance is told no connection exists with Load Demo Data and docs links
findings.observation: const EMPTY_STATE = new RegExp(`No ${THEIR_WORD} found\\.\\s*Load Demo Data\\s*or\\s*Check the documentation`) is matched with getByText/queryByText, which compares only an element's own text nodes. In the extracted section (OverviewDashboard.tsx:624-661) the sentence is one Typography whose own text is 'No Tracker found.  or  for more information.' with the two links as child elements, so the regex can never match. Consequences: (a) :454 'expect(await panel.findByText(EMPTY_STATE)).toBeVisible()' can never pass for a faithful extraction, so the fresh-instance row cannot reach GREEN; (b) every 'never the empty state' falsifier (expectNoEmptyState :346-351, used at :398 :479 :496 :505) and :619 'expect(screen.queryByText(EMPTY_STATE)).not.toBeInTheDocument()' is vacuous: the Overview row at :612 passes today although the Overview renders the empty state for an empty list (OverviewDashboard.tsx:612 'connections.length === 0'). The promised falsifier 'empty state while loading or after a failure' therefore cannot fail.
findings.remediation: Locate the empty state by its existing test id (data-testid="no-connections-alert", already used in OverviewDashboard.test.tsx:670) or match the alert's textContent with a function matcher; assert it contains 'No Tracker found.' and keep the Load Demo Data and Check the documentation link assertions. Then re-confirm RED: the Overview 'still asks' row must fail today on the empty state still being on the Overview, and the failure/refused/loading rows must be able to fail on a shown empty state.
